advisory.summary: module-resolution RCE: the catch-all page route reaches requireModule, which require()s an attacker-controlled path with no bundles-directory containment (Next.js < 5.1.0)

acquisition.notes: Reduced Node repro of the Next.js < 5.1.0 module-resolution RCE (GHSA-5vj8-3v2h-h38v) at tag 5.0.0. A catch-all Express-shaped route (app.get('/:path*', handleRender)) forwards the attacker-controlled page path through render() into the RCE sink requireModule(), which require()s the caller-supplied path with no bundles-directory containment. Dependency-free (hand-rolled router over Node http) so the pure-Go call graph connects ingress to sink.

expected_verdict.label: reasoned_exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: The catch-all route handleRender reaches requireModule through the render hop, and requireModule require()s an attacker-controlled path with no containment check (CWE-94), so the ingress-to-sink taint path is statically complete and reachable. Confirming arbitrary module execution requires a live detonation the current sandbox capability does not exercise here, so analysis stops at reachable-but-unconfirmed (stopped_capability); reasoned, not proven. KnownGap: this row is surfaced in the corpus but not yet measured end-to-end -- until PLAN-020's per-language dispatch and this lane's populated symbol lists and ground truth land, the fixture Loads and Validates cleanly but the stub pipeline emits a uniform verdict, so direction/strength equality is not asserted (assertable_now=false), mirroring the symboltest harness's documented gap.
